name: Crone
source:
Affiliation: Rankage (Tenma)
Job: Tenmaou
Hobby: Exploring caves and the like

「What I'm looking for is interesting things and my brother.」

She won and seized the position of Tenmaou with her strength in the tournament held once every 123 years to decide the king of the Tenma race.

Likes festivals and playing with others. She has a straightforward personality and speaks her mind without hesitation.

She is curious and is strongly interested in the Empire and the Commonwealth. She knows she has a younger brother somewhere and is looking for him.

The Tenma race fought directly with their own abilities without needing to use Tenken. Her fighting style is to attack with overwhelming martial arts and spiritual power.
[Translated from [url=http://www.minatosoft.com/wagahime/chara/chara03.html]official site[/url]]
